title: The Pawn Cannot Take
setup: White has just won a bishop on b4, leaving its king boxed in on e1 behind its own pieces.
hint: Your queen on e7 already owns the e-file. What does that do to the pawn standing on it?
explanation:
## The Idea

{{Nd3#}} lands on a square only the e2 pawn guards, and that pawn cannot move: the queen on e7 would be checking down the open e-file. A knight check can never be blocked, and every square beside e1 is occupied by White's own pieces.
